meta.description: Grows an open cap at the tip of every path, the stipe: guide rays that leave the stipe top and follow the drawn profile out to the margin. Fill the gaps between them with fill_gaps, pose them with margin_waves, cap_lopsided, margin_curl and cap_open, then fill them with strands. The rays carry the hinge of their cap, where it sits and how it looks open, so the nodes after it need no other input. Also gives the hinge (stipe top) as points, cap_margin gives the margin.

plant.description: The stipes, the cap grows at the tip of every path

radius.description: Radius of the open cap, the profile spans from the axis to this radius

profile.description: The outline of the open cap seen from the side, from the top over the stipe to the margin. Width and height keep their proportions, the half width of the box is the radius.

thickness.description: Thickness of the flesh. Connect a curve to thin it from the centre (alpha 0) to the margin (alpha 1).

rays.description: Rays that leave the stipe top, evenly around it. fill_gaps adds more where they drift apart towards the margin.
